Nimbus, a synthetic Berlin software company, said on Monday that growth
continued after its results for 2023.

The company reached about €8.1 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR)
at the end of 2024, the chief executive told TechDaily.

Monthly recurring revenue (MRR) also grew steadily during the year.

Mr Keller put the figure at €675k and called it a record.

Revenue was €4.7 million, the company said.
